# Google Search Console

Google Search Console provides tools to monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot your site's presence in Google Search results.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/google-search-console/.

## Actions

- **Get Sitemap** (read-only): Retrieves information about a specific sitemap for a site.
- **Inspect URL** (read-only): Inspects a url for indexing issues and status in google search console.
- **List Sitemaps** (read-only): Lists all sitemaps for a site in google search console.
- **List Sites** (read-only): Lists all sites owned by the authenticated user in google search console.
- **Search Analytics Query** (read-only): Queries google search console for search analytics data including clicks, impressions, ctr, and position metrics.
- **Submit Sitemap**: Submits a sitemap to google search console for indexing.
